name: Thrive Career Wellness
notes: Site says: "Our cloud-based, AI-enabled platform of career products and services address your changing workforce needs" Site says: "Thrive is trusted by 500+ customers globally" Site says: "Departing employees will get access to five different categories of tools and services through the Thrive marketplace" Site says: "Access support with our self-serve help-desk, video walkthroughs or chat directly with our team." Site says: "Thrive Outplacement for ADP Workforce Now® is available within ADP Marketplace Canada." Outplacement and career transition platform headquartered in Toronto, Canada (legal entity Thrive Career Wellness Inc.). Pages read state services, delivery mode and a partner ecosystem; no pricing, language options, founding year, parent company or API were stated.

review.note: Homepage, About, Outplacement, ADP news and terms read (HTTP 200 in fetch and browser reader); HQ and partner ecosystem confirmed, no pricing, language options or API stated. Terms of use prohibit scraping, so no further pages were read.
